messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to match the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands on a stone sidewalk, then turns, bends slightly, and raises an arm toward the face before standing upright again.","camera":"Medium full shot at eye level, mostly static with slight reframing as the subject moves.","clothing":"Yellow long-sleeve shirt with a white floral pattern, red-and-black plaid trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a tight top bun.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned person with a short face and visible ear, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"An old-style storefront street with dark wooden shop fronts, red curtains, and signs reading “SOAP,” “COCOA POWDER,” and “EGG THE COUNTRIES.”"},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person no longer performs the source's large arm-raising dance. Instead, they stand, turn slightly, bend forward, bring an arm toward the face, and return to an upright stance, broadly matching the reference motion sequence. The original yellow shirt, plaid trousers, blue hair, storefront scene, and static framing remain.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source person's action with the motion shown in the reference, while preserving the source person's identity, clothing, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Exact fidelity of the transferred motion to the reference is difficult to verify frame by frame.
unexpected_changes: The reference motion is only approximately reproduced; some arm and body positions differ from the reference frames.
